title: 第232章 战争之王第231章 给我把船靠过去
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
一位海盗兼水手绝望看向身旁的大副，“二、二当家，咱们继续打吗？”
那名所谓的二当家正打算悄悄后退，脱离对方视线后立刻乘坐小木筏逃走，闻言便感受到那位自称勇者的家伙看向自己，自知无法逃脱，心中叫苦不迭。
打是不可能打的，死路一条。
那些刚刚成为海盗的新兵蛋子压根不知道对方的厉害。
那人刚刚那一跳比他们在没有魔力加持下的舰炮射程还远，也看不出魔力波动的痕迹。
也就是说，对方在没有魔法加持的情况下比实心炮弹还要硬！
他主动放下手中的火铳和藏在腰间的匕首，双手抱头蹲下。
“我，血鲨海盗团二当家，带领全体海盗投降！”
那十几名围拢过来的海盗原本正举着弯刀、短斧和上了弦的弩准备和对方殊死一搏，此时也懵了。
不是，二当家的？
我等欲要死战，陛下何故先降？！
老大是高攻低防的魔法师兼剑士，刚刚不过是大意了，没有闪，被对方了偷袭了而已，我们这么多人还怕他不成？
但也有几个海上老手反应过来，看了一眼二当家，又看了一眼季天，手里的刀柄握了又松。
终于，刀刃在甲板上磕出一声轻响，随即便是接二连三的“叮当”声——武器落地的声音在寂静中格外清晰。
“投降！我投降！”
“别杀我！我就是个打杂的！”
“我也投降！”
季天扫了一眼甲板上那些跪伏的海盗，又偏头看向另一艘船。
那艘老船上的海盗们显然也看到了这边的动静，有人已经调转船头试图逃跑，但不到片刻便被海雀号上的精灵水手用精准的箭矢逼停。
两艘船，接近两百名海盗，一炷香之内尽数俘虏。

季天将海盗头子随手扔在甲板上，对海雀号方向抬手示意。
伊芙琳船长会意，指挥海雀号靠拢过来，几名精灵水手带着绳索跳上白鹭号，手脚麻利地将海盗们绑成一串。
接着，她又招呼海雀号上的大副和二副带人登船，接管了白鹭号与那艘老旧海盗船的船舵。
精灵水手们动作利落，很快将两艘船的帆调整好，与海雀号并行。
伊芙琳站在两船之间的船舷边，目光扫过海盗船甲板上那几门被帆布覆盖的炮位，忽然眯起了眼睛。
“勇者大人，您过来看一眼。”
季天走过去，顺着她示意的方向看去。
伊芙琳已经掀开了其中一门炮的帆布，露出了底下的炮身。
那是一门铸铁火炮，口径比普通商船自卫用的火炮大了近一倍，炮管表面铸造工艺精细，膛线清晰，显然是经过精密加工的成品。
季天对于火炮没多少了解，静静等候着对方的解释
伊芙琳蹲下身，手指在炮管表面的纹路上划过。
“这炮不一般，铸造工艺比我见过的任何一种都要精细，射程和精度至少是老式铜炮的三倍。”
“也就是说，这东西不是海盗自己能造的。”
“当然不是，海盗能抢船、抢货，但抢不了一座铸造厂。这门炮的产地，大概率是某个有完整工业体系的港口城市。”
content_en:
A pirate and sailor looked desperately at the first mate beside him, "Second, second master, shall we continue to fight?"
The so-called second master was about to quietly retreat and escape on a small raft as soon as he was out of sight. Hearing this, he felt the self-proclaimed brave guy looking at him. He knew that he could not escape, and he was complaining in his heart.
It is impossible to fight, it will lead to death.
Those new recruits who had just become pirates had no idea how powerful the other party was.
The man's jump just now was farther than the range of their naval guns without the blessing of magic power, and there was no trace of magic power fluctuations.
In other words, the opponent is harder than a solid cannonball without the blessing of magic!
He took the initiative to put down the gun in his hand and the dagger hidden in his waist, and squatted down with his head in his hands.
"I, the second master of the Blood Shark Pirates, lead all pirates to surrender!"
The dozens of pirates who had gathered around were holding scimitars, hatchets, and strung crossbows, preparing to fight to the death, but they were also stunned at this time.
No, the second in charge?
We are ready to fight to the death, why would Your Majesty surrender first? !
The boss is a magician and swordsman with high attack and low defense. He was just careless and didn't dodge and was attacked by the opponent. Are so many of us still afraid of him?
But a few veterans at sea reacted and glanced at the second master, then at Ji Tian, ​​and then tightened and loosened the handle of the knife in their hands.
Finally, the blade made a soft sound on the deck, followed by a series of "ding-dong" sounds - the sound of the weapon landing was particularly clear in the silence.
"Surrender! I surrender!"
"Don't kill me! I'm just a handyman!"
"I surrender too!"
Ji Tian glanced at the kneeling pirates on the deck, then turned his head to look at the other ship.
The pirates on the old ship had obviously seen what was going on here. Some people had turned the ship around and tried to escape, but within a moment they were stopped by the elf sailors on the Puffin with precise arrows.
Two ships, nearly two hundred pirates, all captured within a stick of incense.
Ji Tian threw the pirate leader on the deck and raised his hand to signal in the direction of the Puffin.
Captain Evelin understood and commanded the Puffin to come closer. Several elven sailors jumped onto the Egret with ropes and quickly tied the pirates into a string.
Then, she called on the first mate and second mate of the Puffin to lead people on board, and took over the rudders of the Egret and the old pirate ship.
The elven sailors moved swiftly and quickly adjusted the sails of the two ships so that they were parallel to the Puffin.
Evelin stood on the side of the ship between the two ships, scanning the cannon emplacements covered by canvas on the deck of the pirate ship, and suddenly narrowed her eyes.
"Master Brave, please come and take a look."
Ji Tian walked over and looked in the direction she indicated.
Evelin had already lifted the canvas of one of the cannons, revealing the cannon body underneath.
It was a cast-iron cannon, with a caliber nearly twice as large as the cannon used by ordinary merchant ships for self-defense. The surface of the barrel was cast with fine craftsmanship and the rifling was clear. It was obviously a precision-machined finished product.
Ji Tian didn't know much about artillery, so he quietly waited for the other party's explanation.
Evelin knelt down and traced the lines on the surface of the barrel with her fingers.
"This cannon is extraordinary. The casting process is more refined than anything I have ever seen. Its range and accuracy are at least three times that of the old copper cannon."
"In other words, this thing cannot be built by the pirates themselves."
"Of course not. Pirates can rob ships and goods, but they cannot rob a foundry. The origin of this cannon is most likely a port city with a complete industrial system."
